issue.title: just check fails at lint (symvision): ExpandedLaunchSegments unused-public in agent/launch_cwd_segments.py
issue.description: Found by the sase-16n land agent at master 9f9c2b702. `just symvision` fails with 'Unused public functions/classes ... ExpandedLaunchSegments in src/sase/agent/launch_cwd_segments.py'. Root cause: cfac28d15 (refactor(agent): split launch_cwd_agents into focused modules) introduced the public dataclass ExpandedLaunchSegments; it is only named inside its own file (definition line 17, return annotation line 32, construction line 111). launch_cwd_agents.py imports only expand_launch_segments and consumes the result by attribute. Fix: make the dataclass private (_ExpandedLaunchSegments) per sase memory symvision.md, or have launch_cwd_agents.py import it for an annotation if that is the intended consumer. The earlier symvision red sase-16l (delete_paths_in_background) is already fixed at HEAD by c87c9d1aa, so this is a different symbol and root cause.
